source: I want clicker game and I want a chill park map that I can walk around In with my roblox character. I want there to be a rebirth buttons that doubles clicks. An admin panel only i have and i can give any amount of clicks up to infinity and can start a 2x event and can talk to every globally in game. I want there to be an egg with pets a uncommon pig pet with a 60% chance to get, a rare cat with a 25% chance to get, an epic dog with a 10% chance to get, a legendary horse with a 1% chance, a mythic shark with a 0.1% chance, and a secret turtle with a 0.01% chance to get. I want no labels or texts on my screen or on the ground too

image_prompt.text: A central spot in the park holding the pet egg and the progression purchases, which every player keeps coming back to
Physical walls blocking higher-tier areas of the park that drop away once bought
Winding walkable paths chaining the egg and upgrade spot to the rest of the park
A calm park to wander around in - grass, trees, benches, gentle terrain
No labels, signs, or floating text anywhere in the world, including on the ground

layout_placement.text: A rebirth button that doubles click output
An owner-only admin area or panel that can grant unlimited clicks, start a 2x event, and broadcast to everyone

notes: The pet egg was promoted to social-hub, whose Upgrades Bazaar text names eggs explicitly.
gate-progression came from the preset; purchase gates normally carry price labels, which fights the no-text request.
Pet rarity percentages, admin powers, and global chat are progression and mechanics concerns with no layout footprint.

open_questions.ask: Should the park read as bright and cartoony, or a naturalistic modern city park?
Is the rebirth button a physical thing you walk up to in the park, or a screen button?

coverage_missing.ask: Is the rebirth button a physical pad in the park or a screen button?
With no on-screen text at all, how should the player see their click count and rebirth progress?

answers.ask: Should the park read as bright and cartoony, or a naturalistic modern city park?
answers.answer: Make it a bright, cartoony chill park that fits a Roblox clicker game.

answers.ask: Is the rebirth button a physical thing you walk up to in the park, or a screen button?
answers.answer: Make the rebirth button a physical button players walk up to in the park, with no text labels.
